findings.suggested: کوشش → استدلال کی شدت (title, spoken labels, sentences); chip short «ڈیفالٹ شدت»
findings.problem: Terminology conflict. Core ur renders reasoning effort «استدلال کی شدت» on every user surface that names it (relay.chrome.model.effort, wire.settings.model_effort.label/help, tui.small.model_picker.effort, cli.exec_help.effort), while «کوشش» is the try/retry word in 15 other mobile ur values and 100 core values («دوبارہ کوشش کریں»). «کوشش» on a picker title therefore reads 'attempt', and the effort chip's spoken label «کوشش، زیادہ» reads 'attempt, more'. For the visible chip «ڈیفالٹ شدت» keeps it short; core's full «ڈیفالٹ استدلال کی شدت» is too wide for the shared row.

findings.suggested: دوسرا پاتھ… · یہ پاتھ بہت لمبا ہے۔ · یہ پاتھ استعمال کریں
findings.problem: Terminology: core ur renders a filesystem path «پاتھ» (16 uses: cli.agents_picture.help.file, tui.authoring.invalid_name, …); «راستہ» means road/way and appears nowhere in ur for a path. The hi translation of the same keys correctly uses the parallel loanword «पाथ».
